fields.description: The DocType this row describes, and the row's own name - so there is exactly one semantic record per document and `semantic/curation.py:sync` can upsert by it.
fields.label: Document

fields.description: Title as the desk shows it, kept so this app's lists read the way the rest of the site does.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: What one row of this table is, in a sentence: "one submitted sales invoice", "one line on a sales invoice". Generated from the CHILD and SUBMITTABLE flags; correct it when the schema's shape and the business's shape disagree.
fields.label: Grain

fields.description: The business description a model reads before it writes SQL. Generated from the DocType's own description and shape; edit it freely - `curated` flips and `sync` stops overwriting it.
fields.label: Description

fields.description: Business words that mean this document, which its schema never says. Retrieval reads them as evidence at weight 3.0 - equal to a matched table-name word (`semantic/retrieval.py:Index.CURATED`). Measured on this bench: declaring words like "revenue" and "sold" on seven documents took gold recall from 37/40 to 40/40, because the stem `revenu` appears in no table's schema at all. Whitespace or comma separated.
fields.label: Synonyms

fields.description: Per-column notes. Only a row whose `synonyms` are set changes retrieval; the rest are here to be read.
fields.label: Fields

fields.description: Everything below is written by `sync` from the live site and is never hand-edited: it is the evidence behind this document's priors.
fields.label: Derivation

fields.description: Whether this DocType is a child table (`istable`). Generated.
fields.label: Is Child Table

fields.description: Documents this child hangs off, comma separated. A child whose parent is absent can be joined to nothing and is dropped from the index. Generated.
fields.label: Parent Documents

fields.description: Rows on this site at the last sync - the usage prior's input. Generated.
fields.label: Row Count

fields.description: Charts, cards and reports pointing at this document - the reporting prior's input. Generated.
fields.label: Reporting Artifacts

fields.description: Columns this site never fills, dropped from the description a model is shown. Generated by `semantic/profile.py`.
fields.label: Empty Columns

fields.description: What this table costs to put in front of a model, in the same tokens retrieval spends against its budget. Generated.
fields.label: Token Cost

fields.description: Set when a human has diverged from the generated text - synonyms written, or the description edited. `sync` preserves a curated row's prose. Maintained by `validate`.
fields.label: Curated

fields.description: Checksum of the description this row was generated with, so `validate` can tell an edited description from an untouched one. Generated.
fields.label: Source Checksum

fields.description: When `sync` last refreshed the generated halves of this row.
fields.label: Generated On
